### Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(rstanarm)
library(broom.mixed)
library(shiny)
library(lubridate)
library(e1071)
library(janitor)
options(scipen = 99)
```

```{r}
aviation <- arrow::read_parquet(here("final_projects/Flight_Delay.parquet"))
```

```{r}
# Take a random sample of 10,000 rows
aviation_sample <- aviation %>% sample_n(10000)
```

```{r}
aviation_subset <- aviation_sample %>%
  mutate(ArrDelayBinary = ifelse(ArrDelay > 15, 1, 0)) 
```

```{r}
aviation_subset$FlightDate <- as.Date(aviation_subset$FlightDate)  # Ensure it's in Date format
aviation_subset$day_of_week <- wday(aviation_subset$FlightDate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE) 
```

```{r}
naive_model_ <- naiveBayes(ArrDelayBinary ~ DestCityName + OriginCityName + day_of_week + Marketing_Airline_Network, data = aviation_subset, laplace = 0.00001)
```


```{r}
model <- readRDS(here("final_projects/stan_glm_model.rds"))

```

```{r}
model
```

```{r}
library(bayesplot)

# Compare observed vs. predicted
y_pred <- posterior_predict(model, newdata = aviation_subset)

# Confusion Matrix
table(Predicted = colMeans(y_pred) > 0.5, Actual = aviation_subset$ArrDelayBinary)

```

```{r}
# Predict posterior probabilities
predictions <- posterior_predict(model, newdata = balanced_data, summary = TRUE)

# Use a custom threshold (e.g., 0.3) for classifying delays
balanced_data <- balanced_data %>%
  mutate(predicted_delay = ifelse(predictions[, "Estimate"] > 0.3, 1, 0))

# Confusion Matrix
table(aviation_subset$ArrDelayBinary, aviation_subset$predicted_delay)
```

Undersampling

```{r}
# Split data into delayed and non-delayed flights
delayed <- aviation_subset %>% filter(ArrDelayBinary == 1)
non_delayed <- aviation_subset %>% filter(ArrDelayBinary == 0)

# Undersample non-delayed flights
set.seed(123)
undersampled_non_delayed <- non_delayed %>% sample_n(size = nrow(delayed))

# Combine the balanced dataset
balanced_data <- bind_rows(undersampled_non_delayed, delayed)

```

```{r}


# Generate predictions and confusion matrix
predictions_balanced <- posterior_predict(model, newdata = aviation_subset)
aviation_subset <- aviation_subset %>%
  mutate(predicted_delay = ifelse(rowMeans(predictions_balanced) > 0.5, 1, 0))

table(Predicted = aviation_subset$predicted_delay, Actual = aviation_subset$ArrDelayBinary)

```

```{r}
   mutate(DepDelayBinary = ifelse(DepDelay > 15, 1, 0))
```

### Logistic Regression

```{r}
# Fit the logistic regression model using rstanarm
logistic_model <- stan_glm(
  ArrDelayBinary ~ DestCityName + OriginCityName + Marketing_Airline_Network + 
    DayofWeek + Holidays + CRSDepTimeHourDis, 
  data = aviation_sample_no_weather_features, 
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior = normal(0, 2),       # Weakly informative prior
  prior_intercept = normal(0, 2),
  chains = 4, 
  iter = 2000, 
  seed = 123
)

# Summarize the model
summary(logistic_model)

# Generate predictions
new_aviation_subset_predictions <- aviation_sample_no_weather_features %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_prob = predict(logistic_model, newdata = ., type = "response"),
    predicted_delay = ifelse(predicted_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
  )

# Create the confusion matrix
new_aviation_subset_predictions %>% 
  tabyl(ArrDelayBinary, predicted_delay) %>%
  adorn_percentages("row") %>%
  adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 2) %>%
  adorn_ns()
```
